interventions.description: Add high-visibility crosswalk markings to designate safe crossing locations in this residential area.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearing
interventions.description: Relocate the large planter to a furniture zone or edge to maintain a clear, consistent walking path width.

interventions.title: Daylighting and Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement parking restrictions near potential crossing points and install curb extensions to improve visibility and shorten crossing distances.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Refresh the existing zebra markings with high-visibility materials to increase prominence to approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Vegetation Maintenance
interventions.description: Prune overhanging trees and clear brush along the fence line to restore the full width of the pedestrian walkway.

interventions.title: New Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Construct a continuous paved sidewalk on the left side of the street to provide a safe, dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Obstruction Removal
